headline: Make the details do the talking.
subheadline: A crafted home-services prebuild built around the work itself: finished rooms, honest materials, clear process, and a straightforward path to an estimate.
description: Grove gives flooring and interiors businesses a visual-first website structure with room for project galleries, close-up material photography, process steps, customer reviews, and estimate requests. Warm typography, considered spacing, and grounded colors give the work a studio-quality frame without getting in the crew’s way.
card_blurb: A tactile, gallery-led home-services site that puts materials, finished projects, and estimate requests in clear view.
seo_description: A tactile home-services website prebuild for flooring and interiors, with project galleries, material details, process storytelling, reviews, and estimate requests.
image_notes: Lead with finished rooms in natural light; let floor texture, grain, and transitions read at a glance.
Mix wide project views with close crops of wood, tile, stone, edges, and other material details.
Show process imagery that feels practical and human: measuring, preparation, installation, and finishing touches.
Use a warm, restrained palette and consistent image treatment so project photography carries the visual weight.
